deadline.value: December 1 application deadline for PhD admission.
deadline.quote: PhD - December 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern Standard Time

gre_general.value: GRE General test scores are optional.
gre_general.quote: The GRE General and Subject test scores are optional.

gre_subject.value: GRE Physics Subject test scores are optional.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE General and Subject test scores are optional.

supervisor.value: Not stated on program admission pages.

funding.value: Financial support guaranteed for the first five years with full tuition and stipend/salary.
funding.quote: Students who are admitted to the PhD program in Physics receive a complete financial support package including full tuition and a stipend/salary for the academic year. Financial support is guaranteed by the department for the first five years for students who are making satisfactory progress towards their PhD.

entry_route.value: Applicants may apply directly to a PhD program with an earned bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: Applicants may apply to a PhD program so long as the equivalent of a bachelor's degree is earned prior to the application semester.
